svg.title: Theorems meet a real finite population
svg.desc: Atoms of IID samples from a binned occupancy law converge, the composed 95 percent radius covers the observed error in every replicate, and the sample sizes at which each premise holds.

g.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Source Sans 3', 'Latin Modern Math', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: THEOREMS MEET A REAL FINITE POPULATION
(b) Error of Red against guaranteed radii
continuity bound at the observed η
(c) Sample sizes on one axis (the population has 16 cells; the rarest has probability 1/8,143)
Population: the binned office training law. 200 IID samples per size, seed 20260929; the 95 % radius covered the true error in every replicate at every size.
